msg: Hi there! My husband and I are staying at a hotel on the Rosario Islands for the next five nights. We're both Advanced Open Water certified, got certified about two years ago. We'd like to do some diving over a few days. What do you offer?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

How lovely that you're staying on the islands — you're going to love diving here. The Rosario Islands are warm, comfortable and full of colorful reef life, and since you're already on Isla Grande we can pick you up right at your hotel (as long as it has boat access). 🤿

All of them include hotel pick-up (if your hotel has boat access), dive insurance, full equipment and a PADI professional with you. Lunch isn't included in these island packages.

One important note: since it's been about two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required — it's the mini course (pool + one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day, so the dive trip can't be done the same day. If you already did a refresher or PADI ReActivate elsewhere, that counts and you can dive directly.

Would you like me to help you put together the booking? If you tell me which package appeals to you, I'll point you to the right link. 😊

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• 9-dive package (4 days): 544 USD · 605 USD (1.695.000 COP · 1.882.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD (830.000 COP · 922.000 COP)
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD (1.000.000 COP · 1.110.000 COP)
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD (1.375.000 COP · 1.526.000 COP)
• Open Water Referral Course: 432 USD · 480 USD (1.565.000 COP · 1.740.000 COP)

Is the other person diving too? 🤿

msg: Yes, both of us dive. Actually, our last dives were only five months ago in Thailand, so I don't think we need a refresher. We'd like three days of diving, maybe the 7-dive one? Is that for both of us, and how do we book?
reply:
Yes—the 7-dive package is priced per person, so you’d book two places. It runs over three days and includes six daytime dives and one night dive. Lunch isn’t included, and hotel pick-up is available if your hotel has boat access.

Since your last dives were five months ago, the usual refresher requirement for divers who haven’t dived in over two years doesn’t apply. — choose your date and two people in the booking calendar. The 10% online discount is applied automatically.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD (1.375.000 COP · 1.526.000 COP)
• Open Water Referral Course: 432 USD · 480 USD (1.565.000 COP · 1.740.000 COP)

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.
